accepted.s:
Under the educational commitments associated with the Thirteenth Schedule, which of the following was NOT included as one of the institutions proposed for Andhra Pradesh?

1. Indian Institute of Technology
2. National Institute of Technology
3. Indian Institute of Management
4. National Institute of Fashion Technology

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The educational commitments included one each of an IIT, NIT, IIM, IISER, Central University, Petroleum University, Agricultural University and IIIT, besides an AIIMS-type hospital, Tribal Universities and NIDM. National Institute of Fashion Technology was not listed.
accepted.tq: Find the institution outside the specified commitment list.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs relating to higher educational institutions in Andhra Pradesh:

1. IIT Tirupati — Yerpedu
2. IIM Visakhapatnam — Gambheeram
3. NIT Andhra Pradesh — Tadepalligudem
4. IISER Tirupati — Kurnool

Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: IIT Tirupati is at Yerpedu, IIM Visakhapatnam is at Gambheeram and NIT Andhra Pradesh is at Tadepalligudem. IISER Tirupati is also at Yerpedu, not Kurnool.
accepted.tq: Use location discrimination among closely related institutions.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: IIT Tirupati was established under which legal instrument?
accepted.x: IIT Tirupati, which started in 2015 at Yerpedu, is associated with the Institutes of Technology (Amendment) Act, 2016.
accepted.tq: Match the institution with its specific establishing law.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: Which one of the following institutions is correctly matched with its location and acreage?
o: Central Tribal University of AP — Marrivalasa, 183 acres
accepted.x: IIT Tirupati is located at Yerpedu on 548 acres. IIM Visakhapatnam occupies 241 acres, AIIMS Mangalagiri 183 acres and the Central Tribal University 490 acres.
accepted.tq: Compare the acreage figures attached to neighbouring institutions.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: IIM Visakhapatnam was started in September 2015 with which institution as its mentor?
accepted.x: IIM Visakhapatnam began in September 2015 at Gambheeram, with IIM Bangalore serving as its mentor institution.
accepted.tq: Recall the mentor institution associated with the date of commencement.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: AIIMS Mangalagiri is associated with the Pradhan Mantri Swasthya Suraksha Yojana (PMSSY), not the IIM Act, 2017. NIT Andhra Pradesh and IISER Tirupati are linked with the NITSER Act, while IIPE is linked with the IIPE Act, 2017.
accepted.tq: Spot the swapped legal basis among similar institutional entries.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding institutions established in Andhra Pradesh is/are correct?

1. AIIMS Mangalagiri started in 2018.
2. IIPE is located in Visakhapatnam and started in 2016.
3. The Central University of Andhra Pradesh is located at Janthaluru in Anantapuramu.
4. The Central University of Andhra Pradesh started in 2015.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: AIIMS Mangalagiri started in 2018, IIPE is at Visakhapatnam and started in 2016, and the Central University of AP is at Janthaluru and started in 2018. Statement 4 is false because it started in 2018, not 2015.
accepted.tq: Separate the correct start years from a deliberately shifted year.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: The Central Tribal University of Andhra Pradesh is located at which place?
accepted.x: The Central Tribal University of AP is located at Marrivalasa/Chinamedapalli in Dattirajeru mandal of Vizianagaram district, on 490 acres.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the tribal university location from other institutional campuses.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:

1. The Central Universities (Amendment) Act, 2019 created both the Central University of AP and the Central Tribal University of AP.
2. The Central University of AP is located at Janthaluru.
3. The Central Tribal University of AP was first proposed near Visakhapatnam and later moved to Vizianagaram.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. The 2019 Amendment Act created both universities; CUAP is at Janthaluru, while the proposed location of CTUAP shifted from near Visakhapatnam to Vizianagaram.
accepted.tq: Combine the establishing law, present location and relocation history.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: IIITDM, Kurnool — Ministry of Education, Institution of National Importance
NIDM Southern Campus, Kondapalli — Ministry of Education, Institution of National Importance
IIPE, Visakhapatnam — Ministry of Home Affairs
accepted.x: IIITDM at Kurnool is under the Ministry of Education and has the status of an Institution of National Importance. The NIDM Southern Campus is associated with the Ministry of Home Affairs, while PMSSY is associated with AIIMS Mangalagiri.
accepted.tq: Match each institution with the responsible ministry or legal status.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: The NIDM Southern Campus associated with Andhra Pradesh is located at:
accepted.x: The Southern Campus of the National Institute of Disaster Management is located at Kondapalli, near Vijayawada, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
accepted.tq: Recall the location of the specialised institution rather than its ministry.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: The number of premier institutions in Andhra Pradesh described as functional by the CDI is:
accepted.x: The CDI count places the number of functional premier institutions in Andhra Pradesh at 11.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact institutional count.
accepted.sec: Educational institution commitments - location and establishing Act

accepted.s: Under the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, the Steel Authority of India Limited was required to examine, within six months, the feasibility of an integrated steel plant in:
accepted.x: The Act required SAIL to examine within six months the feasibility of integrated steel plants in YSR district of Andhra Pradesh and Khammam district of Telangana.
accepted.tq: Recall both locations attached to the statutory feasibility requirement.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s:
Consider the following events relating to the Kadapa steel plant:

A. Land was allotted to Brahmani Steels.
B. Foundation stone was laid at M. Kambala Dinne.
C. Stones were laid again by Y.S. Jagan Mohan Reddy.
D. Construction of the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant was launched.

Which one of the following is the correct chronological order?
accepted.x: Land was allotted during the YSR era of 2004–09, the foundation stone was laid in December 2018, stones were laid again in 2019 and 2023, and JSW construction was launched on 3 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the first and last events, then place the intermediate milestones by year.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding the institutional response to the Kadapa steel plant proposal is/are correct?

1. The Centre and SAIL did not build the plant.
2. The State formed AP High Grade Steels Limited in 2018.
3. The plant was constructed directly by SAIL after its feasibility examination.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: The Centre and SAIL did not build the plant; instead, the State formed its own special-purpose vehicle, AP High Grade Steels Limited, in 2018. Therefore, statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Identify the wrong authority and the State-created special-purpose vehicle.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s: On 3 July 2026, construction was launched for the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant at:
accepted.x: Construction was launched at Sunnapurallapalli and Peddandluru villages in the Jammalamadugu constituency of Kadapa on 3 July 2026.
accepted.tq: Recall the two construction-site villages as a pair.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched with the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant?
o: Developer — AP High Grade Steels Ltd
Developer — JSW Andhra Pradesh Steel Ltd
Estimated investment — ₹16,350 crore in two phases
accepted.x: The developer is JSW Andhra Pradesh Steel Ltd. AP High Grade Steels Ltd was the State-created SPV formed in 2018, not the developer named for the JSW plant.
accepted.tq: Catch the swapped developer name in a project description.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s: The investment pattern for the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant is:
o: ₹16,350 crore in Phase I and no second phase
₹11,850 crore in Phase I and ₹4,500 crore in Phase II
₹5,640 crore in Phase I and ₹10,710 crore in Phase II
₹4,500 crore in Phase I and ₹11,850 crore in Phase II
accepted.x: The total investment is ₹16,350 crore, divided into ₹4,500 crore for Phase I and ₹11,850 crore for Phase II.
accepted.tq: Split the total project investment into its two stated phases.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the JSW Rayalaseema Integrated Steel Plant are correct?

1. It is planned as a scrap-based Electric Arc Furnace green-steel project.
2. It is to receive 2 tmc ft of water per year from Gandikota.
3. The water is to be conveyed through a 15-kilometre pipeline.
4. Commercial production is targeted for 2028.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. The project uses a scrap-based Electric Arc Furnace, has a planned Gandikota water supply of 2 tmc ft per year through a 15-kilometre pipeline, and targets commercial production in 2028.
accepted.tq: Check all technical specifications before selecting the comprehensive option.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s: The first phase of the proposed two-phase investment in the JSW steel project amounts to:
accepted.x: Phase I of the JSW project involves an investment of ₹4,500 crore; Phase II involves ₹11,850 crore.
accepted.tq: Distinguish a phase-specific figure from the total project cost.
accepted.sec: Kadapa steel plant - village, mandal, foundation stone, SAIL feasibility, AP High Grade Steels, JSW

accepted.s: Which of the following Thirteenth Schedule commitments was dropped as non-feasible?
o: Examination of a new railway zone
New major port at Duggirajupatnam with Phase I by the end of 2018
Expansion of Visakhapatnam airport to international standards
accepted.x: The proposed new major port at Duggirajupatnam, for which Phase I was envisaged by the end of 2018, was dropped as non-feasible.
accepted.tq: Identify the commitment whose status is cancellation rather than delay or completion.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: The present port-related development associated with the site of the dropped Duggirajupatnam proposal is described as:
o: A BPCL refinery and petrochemical complex
A VPA–APMB greenfield port and shipbuilding cluster
A new railway zone under SCoR
accepted.x: The present development is described as a VPA–APMB greenfield port together with a shipbuilding cluster.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the current substitute project from other infrastructure commitments.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s:
Consider the following pairs:

1. Greenfield refinery-petrochemical complex — BPCL refinery near Ramayapatnam
2. VCIC — ADB-funded project with slow progress
3. New railway zone — SCoR operational from 1 June 2026
4. Metro rail in Visakhapatnam — Already operational throughout the city

Which of the pairs given above are correctly matched?
accepted.x: The first three pairs are correct. The Visakhapatnam metro project was still before the Centre in 2026 and was not operational throughout the city.
accepted.tq: Reject the completed-status trap attached to an ongoing project.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: Under the Thirteenth Schedule commitment relating to a refinery and petrochemical complex, which organisation was to examine the project?
accepted.x: The Act provided for IOC or HPCL to examine a greenfield refinery-petrochemical complex. The later status mentioned is a BPCL refinery near Ramayapatnam, with final clearances pending in September 2026.
accepted.tq: Separate the originally designated organisations from the later project organisation.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: The Visakhapatnam–Chennai Industrial Corridor (VCIC) commitment was to examine it on the lines of the:
accepted.x: The Thirteenth Schedule provided for examination of VCIC on the lines of the Delhi–Mumbai Industrial Corridor. The project is ADB-funded, but progress has been slow.
accepted.tq: Recall the model corridor used for comparison.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: Which set of airports was specifically identified for expansion to international standards?
accepted.x: The commitment covered the airports at Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati. All three are described as international airports in the stated status update.
accepted.tq: Recall the complete three-airport set rather than a partial list.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: The new airport dedicated on 1 August 2026 is:
o: Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport at Bhogapuram
accepted.x: The Bhogapuram airport was dedicated on 1 August 2026 as the Alluri Sitarama Raju International Airport.
accepted.tq: Match the new airport with its official name and location.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements regarding Bhogapuram airport are correct?

1. It is being built by GMR through GVIAL on a public-private partnership basis.
2. Its cost is over ₹5,640 crore.
3. Its planned capacity is 6 million passengers per year.
4. It is the first greenfield airport in Andhra Pradesh since 2014.

Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. Bhogapuram airport is being developed by GMR through GVIAL on PPP, costs over ₹5,640 crore, is designed for 6 million passengers annually and is the first greenfield airport in AP since 2014.
accepted.tq: Verify the project developer, financing model, cost and capacity together.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: The metro rail feasibility commitment under the Thirteenth Schedule covered which corridors or urban regions?
accepted.x: The commitment was to examine metro rail feasibility for Visakhapatnam and the Vijayawada–Guntur–Tenali region within one year. In 2026, the Vizag metro proposal was still before the Centre.
accepted.tq: Recall both components of a combined regional infrastructure commitment.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s: Which of the following statements correctly reflects the status of the proposed new railway zone?
o: The new railway zone was dropped as non-feasible.
The railway zone is still only under preliminary examination.
The South Coast Railway became operational on 1 June 2026.
The South Central Railway became operational on 1 June 2026.
accepted.x: The South Coast Railway (SCoR) is stated to have become operational on 1 June 2026. It represents the status of the new railway-zone commitment.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between the similar railway-zone abbreviations and names.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status

accepted.s:
Assertion (A): All three airports identified for expansion under the Thirteenth Schedule are described as international airports.

Reason (R): Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati airports were among the airports specified for expansion to international standards.
o: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
accepted.x: Both statements are true, and the identification of Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Tirupati as the airports targeted for international standards explains the stated status of all three.
accepted.tq: Test whether the statutory airport list explains the reported status.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule infrastructure commitments - status
